tickets_54.text: Tickets – Maine Cheese Festival Skip to content Open Facebook in a new tab Open Instagram in a new tab Maine Cheese Festival Home Tickets Programming Film, Cheese & Wine FAQs Cheesemakers Artisan Vendors Food Trucks Maine Cheese Competition Volunteers Sponsors Menu Tickets We appreciate your interest in coming to the Maine Cheese Festival. Every ticket purchased directly supports Maine cheesemakers and the Maine cheese industry. Proceeds help fund year-round educational programs, marketing initiatives, advocacy efforts, and opportunities that strengthen Maine’s artisan cheesemaking community. Your ticket is more than admission—it’s an investment in the farms, families, and businesses that produce some of the nation’s finest cheeses. Explore our full lineup of programming, including cheesemaking demonstrations, tastings, live music, family activities, and more. BUY MY 2026 MAINE CHEESE FESTIVAL TICKETS & MORE! Presenting Sponsor Want to help us at the 2026 Cheese Festival? Sign up to volunteer with us for several hours and get free admission. Volunteers are needed from early in the morning until early evening. Go to the Volunteers Page for more information. artisan_21.text: Artisan Vendors – Maine Cheese Festival Skip to content Open Facebook in a new tab Open Instagram in a new tab Maine Cheese Festival Home Tickets Programming Film, Cheese & Wine FAQs Cheesemakers Artisan Vendors Food Trucks Maine Cheese Competition Volunteers Sponsors Menu Artisan Vendors The Maine Cheese Festival is also proud to showcase a talented lineup of Maine artisans, makers, and specialty food producers whose work complements the spirit of the Festival. From handcrafted foods and small-batch beverages to textiles, kitchen goods, woodcrafts, and culinary-inspired artisan products, these vendors help bring the full flavor and creativity of Maine to life. Together, they create a vibrant marketplace that celebrates craftsmanship, local talent, and the joy of gathering around great food and handmade goods. The Maine Cheese Festival Planning Committee is committed to curating a thoughtful and diverse vendor lineup that celebrates the very best of Maine. Whenever possible, we prioritize vendors who source and use Maine-grown and Maine-made ingredients, products, and materials. 2026 Artisan Vendors (to-date): 27 North, Afterglow Ice Cream, Barters Island Bees, Inc, Bryant’s Brewing, Chef Paul’s, Crooked Wall Farm, Dogpatch Farm, LLC, Dragon’s Breath Pottery, Effie’s Homemade, Farm House Coffee Roasters, Farthest Field Farm, Grey Goose Gourmet, Gryffon Ridge Spice Merchants, Gyst Flavor, Honey Wilde Farm, Honeybee Acres Farm, Hootenanny Bread LLC, Life Of A Potter’s Hands, Maidenhair & Moss Soap Co., Maine Garum Company, Maine Grains/Miller’s Table, Maine Sauce and Provisions, Olde Haven Farm, Pen & Cob Farm, Pressed for Cider, Red Kettle Foods, Spice Hounds, The Milk Bottle, The Scone Goddess, The Sweet Life Kettle Corn Company, Thistle Moon Farmstead, Torrey’s Muffins and Cookies, What The Actual Fudge, and Willows Highlands Farm. Contact us at director@mainecheeseguild.org for more information. Open Facebook in a new tab Open Instagram in a new tab © 2026 Maine Cheese Festival

cheesemakers_57.text: Cheesemakers – Maine Cheese Festival Skip to content Open Facebook in a new tab Open Instagram in a new tab Maine Cheese Festival Home Tickets Programming Film, Cheese & Wine FAQs Cheesemakers Artisan Vendors Food Trucks Maine Cheese Competition Volunteers Sponsors Menu Cheesemakers Maine is home to more than 70 licensed cheesemakers, many of whom are proud members of the Maine Cheese Guild . The Festival is a celebration of the talent, craftsmanship, and creativity behind Maine-made cheese — giving attendees the chance to meet the makers, sample exceptional products, and discover why Maine cheesemakers continue to earn recognition on both national and international stages. 2026 Festival Cheesemaker Vendors: Abraham’s Creamery, Balfour Farm, ChiGoBee Farm, Creamy Acres Creamery, Cosmic Goat Farm, Crooked Face Creamery, Fredrikson Farm, Fuzzy Udder Creamery, Haymay Creamery, Jolly Bleat Farm, Lakin’s Gorges Cheese at East Forty Farm, Maison de Chevre – Artisanal Creamery, ME Water Buffalo Co., Oaklands Farm, Pumpkin Vine Family Farm, Scalawag Farm, Spring Day Creamery, Springdale Farm Creamery + State of Maine Cheese, Sunset Acres Farm and Dairy, The Blue Farmhouse and Seal Cove Cheese, and Whey North Creamery. Contact us at director@mainecheeseguild.org for more information. Open Facebook in a new tab Open Instagram in a new tab © 2026 Maine Cheese Festival

foodtrucks_61.text: Food Trucks – Maine Cheese Festival Skip to content Open Facebook in a new tab Open Instagram in a new tab Maine Cheese Festival Home Tickets Programming Film, Cheese & Wine FAQs Cheesemakers Artisan Vendors Food Trucks Maine Cheese Competition Volunteers Sponsors Menu Food Trucks The Maine Cheese Festival food truck lineup brings even more Maine flavor to the day, serving up everything from savory barbecue and fresh crepes to poutine and other crowd favorites. Whether you’re looking for a quick bite between tastings or settling in for a leisurely lunch, the Festival’s food vendors offer a delicious variety of options that showcase the creativity and comfort of Maine’s vibrant food scene. 2026 FOOD TRUCK VENDOR APPLICATIONS ARE OPEN Applications are due by August 14, 2026. The Maine Cheese Festival Planning Committee is committed to curating a thoughtful and diverse vendor lineup that celebrates the very best of Maine. Whenever possible, we prioritize vendors who source and use Maine-grown and Maine-made ingredients, products, and materials. 2026 Food Truck Vendors: Bowlicious, Cruzin Slice, Downtown Charcuterie, Maine Coast Maté, New England Iron Pollo, Pinky D’s Poutine, Sojourn Ice Co., and The Ugly Dumpling. Contact us at director@mainecheeseguild.org for more information. Open Facebook in a new tab Open Instagram in a new tab © 2026 Maine Cheese Festival
